Job description:

Spyder Industries Australia PTY LTD is hiring a Full-time System Analyst role in Collie, Western Australia. Apply now to become part of our team.

Requirements for this role

Flexible hours available
Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience required for this role
Relevant work rights for Australia
Work location: In person
Spyder Industries Australia PTY LTD is looking for an experienced System Analyst to support the company’s ICT systems and business operations at our Collie, Western Australia location.

On a full-time basis, you will work as part of a multidisciplinary and well-supported team, consulting with business users and technical stakeholders to evaluate existing ICT systems, identify operational requirements, and recommend practical system improvements.

Position Title: System Analyst
ANZSCO Occupation: Systems Analyst – ANZSCO 261112
Employment Type: Full-time
Salary: AU$90,000.00 to AU$98,000.00 per year plus superannuation
Work Location: In person

About the Role

The System Analyst will evaluate the processes, procedures, and methods used in the company’s existing ICT systems and recommend modifications, additional system components, integrations, or new systems to meet operational and user requirements.

The successful applicant will work closely with management, business users, developers, vendors, and ICT support personnel to gather requirements, prepare system specifications, coordinate system testing, and support the implementation of reliable and effective technology solutions.

Requirements

Applicants should demonstrate the following:

Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a System Analyst, Systems Analyst, ICT Business Analyst, or in a closely related ICT systems role
Relevant qualification in Information Systems, Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or an equivalent field
Strong understanding of ICT systems, business processes, system workflows, and operational requirements
Experience consulting with users to gather, analyse, formulate, and document business and system requirements
Experience evaluating existing systems, business processes, procedures, and work practices
Ability to identify system limitations, operational inefficiencies, integration issues, and areas for improvement
Experience preparing functional specifications, system requirement documents, workflow diagrams, process models, data models, and technical documentation
Experience supporting system implementation, integration, configuration, testing, and deployment activities
Understanding of system testing, user acceptance testing, defect tracking, quality assurance, and change management processes
Experience with Microsoft 365, Active Directory, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, enterprise resource planning systems, customer relationship management systems, or similar business platforms
Ability to prepare user guides, training materials, system procedures, technical reports, and operational documentation
Strong stakeholder communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non-technical users
Good analytical, problem-solving, organisational, and project coordination skills
Strong attention to detail and commitment to system quality, data integrity, and continuous improvement
Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a multidisciplinary team
Responsibilities

The System Analyst’s responsibilities will include:

Consult with users, managers, clients, and technical stakeholders to understand operational needs and formulate clear business and system requirements.
Analyse existing ICT systems, business processes, procedures, workflows, and work practices to identify limitations, inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
Evaluate the processes and methods used in existing ICT systems and recommend modifications, additional system components, integrations, or new systems.
Translate user and business requirements into clear functional specifications and system documentation for developers, vendors, and ICT support teams.
Use data modelling, process modelling, workflow mapping, and other analysis techniques to prepare clear system specifications.
Develop business requirement documents, functional requirement specifications, system process diagrams, data flow diagrams, process notes, and implementation documentation.
Review proposed system solutions to ensure they meet business requirements, operational objectives, technical standards, and user expectations.
Work closely with developers, ICT support teams, external vendors, and business users throughout system design, configuration, implementation, and support activities.
Assist with the preparation, adoption, and implementation of system test plans to ensure acceptable system quality, functionality, reliability, and data integrity.
Coordinate and support system testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing, issue identification, defect tracking, and resolution.
Monitor system implementation activities and confirm that approved requirements and functional specifications have been correctly delivered.
Assess system functionality and user feedback and recommend improvements to system usability, performance, workflows, and business processes.
Review and improve user access procedures, account management processes, permission controls, shared data structures, and business application workflows.
Support the deployment of functional ICT solutions and assist users during system transitions, upgrades, and process changes.
Prepare user guides, system procedures, operating instructions, training materials, and technical support documentation.
Deliver system training and provide practical guidance to staff and other business users.
Act as a central source of information and provide advice and assistance during system-related planning and decision-making.
Maintain accurate system records, configuration information, issue registers, testing records, and operational reports.
Monitor system performance, service requests, recurring user issues, and operational incidents to support reliable day-to-day business operations.
Assist with system-related onboarding and offboarding processes, including user account access, permissions, application access, and system usage guidance.
Maintain clear communication with stakeholders and provide practical technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, system functionality, and user experience.
Perform other related system analysis and ICT project duties as reasonably required.
Application

If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and submit an up-to-date CV.

Shortlisted applicants will be contacted to arrange a suitable time to discuss the position, their experience, and their suitability for the role.

Work Location: In person

## Technical Writer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer to join our team and produce clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that supports both internal operations and end-user understanding. This role is central to bridging the gap between complex technical concepts and accessible written content across a range of formats and platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong research capabilities, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, developers, and stakeholders. A background in a technical discipline combined with a passion for clear communication would make you an exceptional fit for this position.

## Key Responsibilities

- Research, develop, and maintain a broad range of technical documentation including user manuals, handbooks, training materials, standard operating procedures, and multimedia content

- Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and accurate content tailored to the intended audience, whether end users, internal teams, or stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, product managers, and subject matter experts to gather information and verify technical accuracy across all documentation

- Plan, organise, and manage documentation projects from initial brief through to final publication, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met

- Review and edit existing documentation to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or outdated content, and update materials to reflect product or process changes

- Develop and apply style guides, templates, and documentation standards to ensure consistency in tone, format, and terminology across all written outputs

- Produce content for digital and print formats including online help systems, knowledge bases, e-learning modules, and technical reference guides

- Liaise with stakeholders to understand documentation requirements and translate business or technical briefs into structured, reader-focused content

- Conduct quality assurance reviews of documentation prior to release, checking for technical accuracy, readability, grammar, and adherence to brand and style guidelines

- Support the development of training materials and contribute to onboarding programmes by producing clear instructional content for new users or staff

- Manage version control and document repositories, ensuring all materials are correctly filed, versioned, and accessible to relevant teams

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Demonstrated experience in a technical writing role, ideally within a corporate, technology, or engineering environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- Proven ability to research, interpret, and document complex technical subjects in a clear and accessible manner

- Proficiency in documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Confluence, Microsoft Word, or equivalent platforms

- Experience working with content management systems, version control tools, and document repositories

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines

- Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Sound understanding of documentation best practices, including the use of style guides such as the Microsoft Manual of Style or equivalent

## Preferred Qualifications

- Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Technical Communication, such as a Certificate IV in Professional Writing and Editing or equivalent

- Experience with API documentation, software development lifecycle (SDLC), or working within Agile project environments

- Familiarity with graphic design or multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Snagit, or Camtasia to support visual documentation

- Exposure to single-sourcing methodologies and structured authoring frameworks such as DITA

- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or engineering where documentation compliance is essential

## Why Join Us?

- Flexible working arrangements including hybrid and remote options to support a healthy work-life balance

- A collaborative, inclusive team culture that values expertise, continuous learning, and professional growth

- Access to ongoing training, professional development programmes, and support for further education or industry certifications

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to product quality, customer experience, and organisational knowledge

- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits reviewed annually in line with performance

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift

- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Wenty Developers Pty Ltd
71 Saunders Road, Oakville, NSW 2765

Building Associate 
(Contracted as Site Supervisor) – Full-time 
SALARY $88,000 + Superannuation per year

DUTIES
•	Assist in planning, coordinating and monitoring residential construction projects, including new homes, duplexes, granny flats, renovations and extensions.
•	Interpret architectural drawings, specifications, building codes and construction standards to support the accurate execution of building works.
•	Coordinate daily site activities by scheduling subcontractors, trades, materials and equipment to ensure efficient project delivery.
•	Inspect construction work and building materials to ensure compliance with approved plans, quality standards, the National Construction Code (NCC) and relevant Australian Standards.
•	Monitor construction progress, identify and resolve on-site issues, and report project status, timelines and quality outcomes to management.
•	Estimate material quantities, assist in preparing quotations and monitor material usage to support cost-effective project delivery.
•	Liaise with clients, subcontractors, suppliers, certifiers and other stakeholders to coordinate construction activities and resolve site-related matters.
•	Conduct routine site inspections to ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements and maintain a safe working environment.
•	Assist in coordinating project schedules, monitoring construction timelines and supporting the timely completion of projects within budget.
•	Maintain accurate site records, inspection reports, progress documentation and project-related correspondence throughout all stages of construction.

REQUIRED SKILLS
•	Associate Degree, Diploma or higher qualification in Building, Construction Management, Civil Construction, or a closely related field.
•	Minimum 1 years' relevant experience in residential construction, site supervision or building coordination.
•	Sound knowledge of the National Construction Code (NCC), Australian Standards and Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) requirements.
•	Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, construction plans and specifications.
•	Strong organisational, communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced construction environment.
•	Current White Card is essential. A current Australian driver's licence is highly desirable.


How to apply:

Applications open on 6 July 2026 and close on 5 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

result.description:
Eyria Investments is a leading Tourist, Holiday and Private accommodation provider in Port Lincoln South Australia. Facilities include Bed & Breakfast properties, Worker Accommodation, Tourist Accommodation (RV & Cabins) and private rental properties. 
Eyria are looking fulfil five (5) positions on a Fulltime basis.

Approximate Start date: September 2026

JOB SUMMARY:
Successful applicants will need to perform the following Duties.
•	Cleaning/Housekeeping of all Tourist Park cabins and sites as per the cleaning guidelines
•	Cleaning of Amenity Blocks at the Tourist Park
•	Cleaning of Guest laundry facilities at the Tourist Park
•	Laundering of Linen/Manchester utilising onsite commercial machines 
•	Liaise with reception/administration staff at the Tourist Park regarding customer requirements.
•	General duties as required or advised by the Park Manager/Park Supervisor
•	Cleaning/Housekeeping of all Eyria Investments apartment accommodation
•	Cleaning off site for other contracted locations
•	Ensure a friendly nature to all guests at Eyria Investments properties
•	Cleaning of Worker Accommodation Facilities leased from Eyria Investments

Operational Hours:
Facilities are operating 7 days per week all year and facilities require continuous service.
Typical hours are: 38 hours per week 7am – 3:30pm on a rotating 7 day roster. Successful candidates can expect to work any 5 days of the 7 day week.
(There may be requirements to perform after hours tasks)
This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to the role.
REMUNERATION:
Renumeration is paid as per the Award Rate, paid on a fortnightly basis. Work completed at all sites will be calculated at the applicable hourly Award Rate. Penalty and overtime rate will be applied where applicable. (https://awards.fairwork.gov.au/MA000009.html)
INDUCTION & TRAINING:
•	All staff to be inducted to all sites
•	Safety drills conducted bi-monthly
•	Machinery and equipment training and assessment  
•	SOP’s to be discussed for operations 
•	Chemical use and hazard training

This is not a FIFO position. Successful applicants will need to based in Port Lincoln for the duration of the contracted period.
